authPanel.openBody: Find libraries can narrow any list to places open right now, checked against each library's own time zone.
authPanel.zoomTitle: Zoom in to split the clusters
authPanel.zoomBody: Numbered circles on the map break apart into individual libraries as you zoom towards street level.
authPanel.fixTitle: Spotted a mistake? Suggest a fix
authPanel.fixBody: Every library page has a correction link. Each change is reviewed before it goes live.
authPanel.eventsBody: The events calendar gathers exhibitions, talks and reading groups from the libraries that publish them.
authPanel.devicesBody: Settings lists every device signed in to your account. Sign out any you don't recognise.
authPanel.passwordlessBody: On the sign-in page, choose “Email me a sign-in link” for a link that signs you in once.
authPanel.passphraseBody: A long passphrase is easier to remember than a short password full of symbols, and harder to guess.
authPanel.createBody: Email and password, Google or Discord.
authPanel.confirmBody: Open the link we send you.
authPanel.profileBody: Choose a username and your interests.
authPanel.signinSubtext: Browsing and every library record are free without an account. Sign in to contribute and follow libraries.
authPanel.registerSubtext: Three short steps, then you can start improving records. Every change is reviewed and credited to you.
authPanel.verifySubtext: Your account is created. Confirm your email, choose a username, and you can start improving records.
authPanel.accountSubtext: Change your password, or add one if you use a social sign-in. Library records stay free either way.

authInterface.passwordHint: At least {count, number} characters. A few unrelated words works well.
authInterface.socialConsent: By continuing with Google or Discord, you confirm you’re {age, number} or over and agree to our <terms>terms of use</terms> and <privacy>privacy notice</privacy>.

contributionSession.changed: Your account or permissions changed. Reloading the contribution page before showing saved work.
contributionSession.unavailable: We couldn’t confirm your account. Reload to try again.

featureAccess.eyebrow: More ways to use Libraries Global
featureAccess.accountNote: Use your existing account, or create one for free. Any extra access requirements are explained here.
featureAccess.teamTitle: Your next step: a staff workspace
featureAccess.teamNote: These tools live in a free staff workspace. Create one, or ask your organiser to invite you. Editing a library still needs your own verified staff access.

networks.title: Sign in to manage your service or network
networks.lead: Connect your libraries and request the access you need to keep a service’s records up to date.

benefits.one: Confirm your affiliation with a library service or network.
benefits.two: Request management access across the libraries you look after.
benefits.three: Follow the progress of requests and see your approved scope.

networks.requirement: A free account lets you request affiliation. Service-management access is reviewed separately; paying for a plan does not grant it.

teams.title: Sign in to bring your Team together
teams.lead: Connect colleagues, organise membership and use tools built for library services.

benefits.one: Invite colleagues and manage Team membership.
benefits.two: Connect your service’s libraries with the right people.
benefits.three: Build widgets for your website from the libraries you look after.

teams.requirement: Workspaces are free. Membership never grants library editing: that needs your own verified staff access to each library.
teams.memberTitle: Bring your service together with a Team

widgets.title: Sign in to put library data on your website
widgets.lead: Create maps, directories and charts that stay connected to published library records.

benefits.one: Reuse a selection of libraries across different formats.
benefits.two: Shape a map, directory or comparison for your website.
benefits.three: Preview drafts and manage publication from your workspace.

widgets.requirement: Widgets are free in a staff workspace. Editing and publishing follow your role in the workspace.
widgets.memberTitle: Put library data on your website with a free workspace

api.title: Sign in to connect your application
api.lead: Build with public library data through API Access.

benefits.one: Connect your own tools to published library records.
benefits.two: Manage keys for yourself or your organisation.
benefits.three: See request allowances and usage in one place.

api.requirement: API Access is a separate monthly subscription. A free account, recognition or staff verification doesn’t include it.
api.memberTitle: Connect your application with API Access

claim.title: Sign in to claim your library
claim.lead: Work at a library? Keep its public record accurate at the source.
claim.action: Sign in to claim a library
claim.publicAction: Find your library in the index

benefits.one: Keep hours, services and accessibility information current.
benefits.two: Publish notices and connect an events feed.
benefits.three: Manage mobile routes and stops where your library offers them.

claim.requirement: Claiming and maintaining a library is free. A moderator checks your role and evidence before staff editing is enabled.

index.title: Sign in to improve a library record
index.lead: A small, sourced correction helps everyone who uses the index.

benefits.one: Find the library and check what is already recorded.
benefits.two: Add hours, photos, accessibility details or a reliable source.
benefits.three: Save a draft and follow your suggestion through review.

index.requirement: A free account is enough to suggest changes. Ordinary contributions are reviewed before publication.

add.title: Sign in to put a library on the map
add.lead: Know a library that is missing? Add what you know and help others find it.
add.action: Sign in to add a library

benefits.one: Start with its name, library type and a source.
benefits.two: Add its location, hours and services as you find them.
benefits.three: Save your draft and receive feedback from a reviewer.

add.requirement: Adding a library is free. Check for an existing record first; an editor reviews your submission before it goes live.

writing.title: Sign in to share a library story
writing.lead: Write for the Journal and discover how to help maintain Knowledge.

benefits.one: Propose a story about a library, a visit or a discovery.
benefits.two: Keep drafts and follow editorial feedback in one workspace.
benefits.three: Explore Knowledge and the roles that maintain its guides.

writing.requirement: Free accounts can propose Journal stories. Publishing Knowledge requires an editorial role, approved separately from membership.

roles.title: Sign in to find your contributor role
roles.lead: Help maintain guides, edit stories or review the community’s suggestions.

benefits.one: Choose a role that matches your experience and interests.
benefits.two: Explain the languages and topics you can help with.
benefits.three: Follow your application and any requests for more information.

roles.requirement: Contributor roles are reviewed using experience, contribution history and the role’s requirements. Payment does not buy approval.

accessLocks.reachApi: API customers get a larger allowance, including Reach for a whole library service.
accessLocks.layerIncluded: {name} is free with any signed-in account.
accessLocks.layersFooter: Library facts are free for everyone. Context layers and analysis are free with an account, and Reach unlocks with your first accepted contribution.
accessLocks.csvSignIn: CSV downloads are free with an account. Sign in to download.
accessLocks.exportNote: Exports are free with an account: up to {rows, number} libraries per download, {perDay, number} downloads a day.
accessLocks.serviceReachApi: Reach for a whole library service is available to API customers.
accessLocks.reachWeekUsed: You’ve used this week’s {count, plural, =2 {two new Reach calculations} one {# new Reach calculation} other {# new Reach calculations}}. Results you’ve already calculated stay free to reopen, and each calculation counts for seven days from when you ran it.
accessLocks.reachDialogLead: Reach estimates how many people live within a 5, 10, 15 or 30-minute walk or bike ride of a library.
accessLocks.reachPathContributorBody: Free. Your first accepted contribution unlocks {count, plural, =2 {two new Reach calculations} one {# new Reach calculation} other {# new Reach calculations}} a week; reopening results is free.
accessLocks.reachPathApiBody: For organisations: {perHour, plural, one {# calculation} other {# calculations}} an hour and Reach for a whole library service of up to {libraries, plural, one {# library} other {# libraries}}.
accessLocks.reachSignInHint: Contributing needs a free account. <signIn>Sign in</signIn> or <register>create one</register> first.
accessLocks.serviceReachDialogTitle: Reach for a whole library service
accessLocks.serviceReachDialogLead: Estimate the residents a whole library service reaches, using its mapped reporting area. Overlapping catchments count once.
